decisions.text: one colour for every mark: every variable is on the rows or columns (G7.50)
type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
one shared scale: one scale for every panel, so that sizes compare across panels (G7.48)
the values are not far from zero compared with their spread
scale 0–60 by 20 (at most 5 intervals in a panel about 57 pt high)
the title wraps onto two lines
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
highlighted, twice as thick, in the strong shade of its hue, its label bold: Credit card, Central; the others keep their colours and widths
the unit's description on its own line above the scale (inline it would meet the line of Credit card, Central): “in donations”; “$60K” stays on the top label
digits hidden: thousands, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$60K in donations”
highlighted, twice as thick, in the strong shade of its hue, its label bold: Check, Central; the others keep their colours and widths
time axis: row 1 full, every sixth label, restarting in each group
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
3 × 5 panels of equal size, abutting, divided by light separators, no box round a panel (G7.51); each 57 pt wide and 57 pt high

scale labels left of the first column, the unit phrase once on the first row's top label and the other rows' top labels keeping the number's currency and magnitude; time labels only under the bottom row; column headers above the top row; row headers at the left, horizontal (G7.49)

findings.message: panels.arrangement rows by payment method, columns by region departs from the procedure, which gives columns by region, series in each panel by payment method (the insight compares method directly (facts.compare): drawn as series in each panel (RP3-4, G1.19); the panels facet on region)
findings.recommended: columns by region, series in each panel by payment method
